articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), today announced that its Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Tom Szlosek, will participate in Morgan Stanley’s 14 th Annual Laguna Conference on Thursday, September 17, at 7 a.m. Pacific time. Mr. Szlosek will speak to investors in a fireside chat about the Company’s strategy, financial performance, capital allocation, current trends affecting the business, and other related matters. A live webcast of the event will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website under “Events Presentations” at investors.autonation.com . A replay will be available following the event at the same location. About AutoNation, Inc. AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs. articles.summary: AutoNation is investing an additional $1 million through 10 grants of $100,000 each to organizations advancing cancer research and patient support Together with more than 20,000 Associates nationwide, AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE:AN) celebrates a decade of DRV PNK and more than $50 million raised and donated to drive out cancer. To commemorate these milestones, AutoNation announced an additional $1 million investment through 10 grants of $100,000 each to 10 longtime partners advancing cancer research and supporting patients, survivors, and caregivers. Over the past decade, DRV PNK has evolved into a defining part of AutoNation’s culture, uniting Associates, customers, vendors, and nonprofit partners in the fight against cancer. Mike Manley, AutoNation CEO, presenting a $1 million donation to longtime nonprofit partners advancing research and patient support. Photo credit: Taylor Smith/Blue Eye Images The 10 grants were announced at AutoNation’s headquarters in Fort Lauderdale during DRV PNK
